parts.problem_md:
Read Text A, *Ships, boats and yachts*, in the[ insert](https://www.savemyexams.com/igcse/english-language/cie/past-papers/paper/ppr_cswTDKdfSQy7hG9t/?pdf=https%3A%2F%2Fpastpapers.co%2Fcie%2FIGCSE%2FEnglish-First-Language-0500%2F2023-May-June%2F0500_s23_in_13.pdf&type=resource&resourceIndex=0) and then answer Question 1(a-f).

**1(c) Use your own words** to explain **two** differences between ships and boats as described in Text A.
parts.solution_md:
- A boat is small to mid-sized whereas a ship is larger and specifically designed for a purpose **[1 mark]**
- A boat can be any kind of watercraft, while a ship is built to carry cargo or passengers **[1 mark]**
- Ships have greater cargo-carrying capacity than boats **[1 mark]**

[Total: 2 marks]

> **[mark-scheme]**
> Award 1 mark for each of up to 2 differences clearly stated in own words:
> 
> - (size/capacity) boats are small/medium; ships can carry more cargo than boats
> - (purpose) ships are specifically designed to carry cargo or passengers; boat is a general term for many types of watercraft
> - (definition) ship is a precise category; boat is a broad, general term
> 
> Accept any clearly expressed paraphrase. Do not award if candidate has lifted directly from the text without any attempt at own words
